content_blocks.label: clause_1._Termination_of_Tenancy
content_blocks.text: The tenancy at the premises located at 456 Elm Street, Oakville City, Oakville County, State of Verano, is hereby terminated effective August 30, 2024.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Reason_for_Termination
content_blocks.text: The tenant has failed to comply with the terms of the lease agreement, specifically regarding maintenance of the property.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._Removal_of_Personal_Property
content_blocks.text: Tenant is required to remove all personal property from the premises within five (5) days of receipt of this notice.
